title: Somatic epimutations cap genetic determinism in the human diploid chromatin epigenome
title_zh: 体细胞表观突变限制人类二倍体染色质表观遗传组的遗传决定论
abstract: Diploid human cells contain two non-identical genomes, and differences in their regulation underlie human development and disease. We present Fiber-seq inferred regulatory elements (FIRE) and show that FIRE provides a more comprehensive and quantitative snapshot of the accessible chromatin landscape across the 6 Gbp diploid human genome, overcoming previously unrecognized biases in existing regulatory element catalogs. FIRE enables comprehensive detection of haplotype-selective chromatin accessibility (HSCA), exposing imprinted elements lacking underlying parent-of-origin differences in DNA methylation and gene regulatory modules that permit genes to escape X chromosome inactivation. We uncover that the human leukocyte antigen (HLA) locus harbors the most HSCA in immune cells, where we resolve specific transcription factor (TF) binding events disrupted by disease-associated variants. Finally, we demonstrate that the regulatory landscape of a cell is littered with autosomal somatic chromatin epimutations that are propagated by clonal expansions to create mitotically stable and non-genetically deterministic chromatin alterations.
abstract_zh: 人类二倍体细胞包含两个非同源基因组，调控差异是人类发育和疾病的根源。我们提出了 Fiber-seq 推断的调控元件（FIRE），并证明 FIRE 能提供更全面、定量的可及染色质景观快照，覆盖整个 6 Gb 的人类二倍体基因组，克服了现有调控元件目录中未被识别的偏差。FIRE 使得能够全面检测等位基因选择性染色质可及性（HSCA），揭示了缺乏 DNA 甲基化亲本来源差异的印记元件，以及允许基因逃避 X 染色体失活的基因调控模块。我们发现人类白细胞抗原（HLA）位点在免疫细胞中拥有最多的 HSCA，并解析了疾病相关变异破坏的特定转录因子（TF）结合事件。最后，我们展示了细胞的调控景观中遍布着自体体细胞染色质表观突变，这些突变通过克隆扩增被传播，形成了有丝分裂稳定且非遗传决定的染色质改变。
